groups.label: Categories & tags
groups.description: How the catalog is organised: categories, tags, brands, attributes and shipping classes.

groups.label: Shipping
groups.description: Shipping zones, the regions they cover and the methods offered in each.

groups.label: Orders
groups.description: Orders, totals, line items and customer addresses.

groups.label: Posts & pages
groups.description: WordPress blog posts and pages. Products and orders are not affected.

groups.label: Products
groups.description: Names, prices, stock, categories and images.

groups.label: Reports
groups.description: Sales totals, best sellers and store statistics.

groups.label: Coupons
groups.description: Discount codes, their amounts, limits and expiry dates.

groups.label: Taxes
groups.description: Tax rates by country and region, and the tax classes products are assigned to.

groups.label: Reference data
groups.description: WooCommerce's own reference lists of countries, regions and currencies.

groups.label: Variations
groups.description: The size, colour and other variants of a variable product, each with its own price and stock.

groups.label: Reviews
groups.description: Customer reviews and ratings, including reviewer names and email addresses.

groups.label: Refunds
groups.description: Refunds against orders. Creating one moves money back to the customer.

groups.label: Store settings
groups.description: Store configuration values, including currency, tax behaviour and checkout options.

groups.label: System & maintenance
groups.description: Environment report and WooCommerce's maintenance tools. The most dangerous group here.

groups.label: Customers
groups.description: Registered customers and their addresses. Guest buyers appear under Orders.

groups.label: Payment gateways
groups.description: Which payment methods exist and whether each is enabled. Credentials are never returned.
